description: Claude Code is Anthropic's terminal-based coding agent, containerized here (Node 22 + git/ssh/curl, running as a non-root user) so it can be exec'd into as an isolated sandbox instead of installed on the host. Built from https://github.com/yo-repo87/claude-code-docker.

env.description: Get one at https://console.anthropic.com/ (leave blank to authenticate interactively with /login after attaching instead)
env.label: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

env.description: Set to true to always run with --dangerously-skip-permissions. Only enable this for trusted, sandboxed use.
env.label: CLAUDE_SKIP_PERMISSIONS
env.name: CLAUDE_SKIP_PERMISSIONS

name: claude-code
note: This container has no web UI — after deploying, open Portainer's Console for this container and attach to a shell (or directly to the claude command) to use it interactively. Your project files belong in the /workspace volume; Claude Code's own login/session state is kept in /home/claude/.claude so it survives restarts.
title: Claude Code
